title: Frog holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- frog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#4cc95a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='26' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#2f9e41' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#b7f0a8'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='78' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#3fb84f' transform='rotate(-15 26 78)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='78' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#3fb84f' transform='rotate(15 74 78)'/>
  <!-- feet toes -->
  <circle cx='17' cy='80' r='3' fill='#2f9e41'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='84' r='3' fill='#2f9e41'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='80' r='3' fill='#2f9e41'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='84' r='3' fill='#2f9e41'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='26' ry='21' fill='#5ad86a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='26' ry='21' fill='none' stroke='#2f9e41' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- eye bumps -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='22' r='12' fill='#5ad86a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='22' r='12' fill='#5ad86a'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='22' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#2f9e41' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='22' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#2f9e41' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- eyeballs -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='22' r='7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='22' r='7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='22' r='4' fill='#17223a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='22' r='4' fill='#17223a'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='20' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='20' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 42 Q50 52 62 42' fill='none' stroke='#2f9e41' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='4' fill='#ff9db5' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='40' r='4' fill='#ff9db5' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- arms holding heart -->
  <path d='M30 58 Q28 50 36 48' fill='none' stroke='#3fb84f' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 58 Q72 50 64 48' fill='none' stroke='#3fb84f' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d='M50 60 C42 52 26 50 28 38 C30 28 44 30 50 40 C56 30 70 28 72 38 C74 50 58 52 50 60 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M50 60 C42 52 26 50 28 38 C30 28 44 30 50 40 C56 30 70 28 72 38 C74 50 58 52 50 60 Z' fill='none' stroke='#c92a48' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.85'/>
</svg>
